name: BF-RAC database
description: A curated, source-traceable database of 334 records from 20 experimental studies on concrete made with recycled concrete aggregate (RCA) and basalt fiber, with mix proportions (kg/m³), RCA and fiber properties, test age and compressive, flexural and splitting tensile strength. Every value is traced to its table, figure or section in the source; conversions, assumptions and inconsistencies found in the sources are documented for each record. 245 values were copied from tables, 41 digitized from charts at pixel level and 21 taken or derived from the text, and each record is flagged accordingly. The record also contains the Python code and all results of the accompanying paper, which compares seven machine-learning models under random and leave-lab-out validation and estimates the effect of basalt fiber by random-effects meta-analysis. Under leave-lab-out validation no model predicted strength better than the mean, while the pooled fiber effect was ×1.13 (95% CI 1.04–1.23) for flexural and ×1.14 (1.08–1.19) for splitting tensile strength, with high between-laboratory heterogeneity (I² 92–96%).
